targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicCore. Claim only task rg7-core-per-recipe-freshness-primitives-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-6 Core vector availability is accepted at AlembicCore commit 9eec6303549c3678bc1b0910d5d7fd3b7d3b992f; RG-6 Plugin consumer migration is accepted at AlembicPlugin commit a68b17f6e3b2cdd17e5d31b38df9c0516d2c1e06. Requirement authority: RG-7 timing repair says create/evolve must immediately update per-recipe source_refs and vector state so Plan projected generation-state and recipe retrieval are fresh after creation/evolution. Controller code-fact precheck found current Core has full SourceRefReconciler.reconcile(), RecipeSourceRefRepository, VectorService.syncEntry(), syncRecipeSemanticRegions(), and getAvailability(), while Plugin still has a local _populateSourceRefsForEntry event helper; no confirmed Core single-recipe source_refs + vector freshness facade was found. Goal: implement only the Core producer primitive needed for RG-7, additive and package-boundary clean. Required behavior: (1) Inspect current Core source-ref, knowledge, vector, plan projection, and recipe-context paths first, especially src/service/knowledge/SourceRefReconciler.ts, src/repository/sourceref/RecipeSourceRefRepository.ts, src/service/vector/VectorService.ts, src/service/knowledge/RecipeProductionGateway.ts, src/service/knowledge/KnowledgeService.ts, and Core export facades. (2) Provide a deterministic Core service/helper/facade for refreshing one or a bounded list of Recipe ids/entries after create/evolve. It must update recipe_source_refs for only the affected recipe(s), including inserting current reasoning.sources refs, marking active/stale using the same project-scope resolution semantics as SourceRefReconciler, and removing source refs that were dropped from that recipe without deleting unrelated rows. (3) After source_refs are reconciled, refresh the corresponding vector entry and recipe semantic-region vectors through existing VectorService APIs where data is available; use RG-6 getAvailability()/isAvailable() to report degraded/unavailable vector state instead of silently treating provider absence as success. (4) Return structured status suitable for Plugin consumption: affected recipe ids, sourceRef inserted/active/stale/cleaned/skipped or equivalent counts, vector entry/region sync status, availability/degraded reason, errors, no-op/table-inaccessible cases, and whether retrieval may be stale. (5) Expose only the minimum public Core surface needed by downstream Plugin; follow AlembicCore export/public-api boundary rules and keep existing four MCP business semantics untouched. (6) Keep full reconcile/rescan/repair paths working; do not replace SourceRefReconciler.reconcile(), do not delete evidence/proposals/vector structures, and do not create Plugin-local state. (7) Add focused tests proving single-recipe refresh inserts active refs, marks stale refs, removes dropped refs only for that recipe, does not touch another recipe's refs, calls/skips vector refresh according to availability, reports degraded availability observably, and preserves existing reconcile/vector tests. Boundaries: do not edit AlembicPlugin in this package except to report that no Core change is needed if raw evidence proves an existing public Core surface already satisfies the task; do not implement Plugin create/evolve wiring, RG-8 commit-driven unified evolution/rename/new-module routing, RG-9 cleanup, RG-10 BiliDili real scenario, daemon/watch behavior, git commit base/merge-base catch-up, or Plan double-write changes. Do not return a type-only shell, static mock, or unused adapter. If the slice is too broad or an existing Core API is already sufficient, return blocked/needs-review with raw evidence, the smallest safe split, and the recommended Plugin consumer package. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted Core tests for the new per-recipe freshness primitive and any touched SourceRefReconciler/RecipeSourceRefRepository/VectorService paths; public API/export boundary checks if exports change; npm run lint or npm run check when feasible; git diff --check; Alembic Guard over changed files. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, exact validation outputs, evidence refs, risks, and downstream Plugin wiring notes.
